old_problem: Both earlier AI conclusions understated the command: IPMI Chassis Control value 4 pulses a Diagnostic Interrupt, typically an NMI, which may log, panic, dump, reboot or hang a running OS. The platform-specific handler/terminal oracle and recovery were missing.
disposition_reason: IPMI 2.0 section 28.3 authoritatively defines Chassis Control 4h as pulse Diagnostic Interrupt; Intel platform documentation explains the NMI/core-dump role. Thus core command semantics are known. ED-04/15/20 allow the specific OS NMI/watchdog/crashdump response, timeout and recovery as project configuration, with mandatory one-shot authorization and no retry.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2245, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2246 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00028-V001 / 27790cef3fc6c7eb was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Intel IPMI 2.0 Chassis Control defines value 4h as an optional Diagnostic Interrupt pulse to the processor; it is an action, not a read query.
Bind SUT/BMC/BIOS/OS/kernel/IPMI transport and the platform's NMI/diagnostic handler, watchdog, panic, crashdump and reboot policy.
Use a dedicated drained DUT, prove independent console/OOB access, dump capacity/destination and hang/boot-loop recovery before authorization.
Capture power/SEL/kernel/console/dump pre-state, then obtain explicit one-shot approval for the exact target and literal command.
If later authorized, execute once and separately evaluate IPMI completion and the documented OS diagnostic response through its terminal timeout; preserve dump identity/integrity when expected.
Stop on wrong target, unsupported handler, missing dump/recovery or unexpected power/thermal/BMC event; never retry or force reset/power automatically.
No login, diagnostic interrupt/NMI, crash/panic/dump/reboot, recovery, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: One-shot IPMI chassis Diagnostic Interrupt and OS response
test_case.purpose: Exercise the standard IPMI Diagnostic Interrupt once on an isolated booted OS and verify the signed platform-specific NMI/diagnostic, crashdump and recovery behavior rather than misclassifying it as a read-only status query.
required_package: Platform support for Chassis Diagnostic Interrupt plus NMI/watchdog/panic/crashdump policy
Expected terminal response, markers, timeout and dump destination/capacity
Dedicated maintenance/workload drain, console/OOB access, final state and hang/boot-loop/dump-failure recovery
test_case.test_command: DO NOT execute without one-shot approval. After read-only readiness checks prove the isolated target, console and dump/recovery path, run exactly `ipmitool chassis power diag` once, capture stdout/stderr/exit/timestamp, and observe console, kernel, watchdog, panic/dump/reboot and SEL evidence to the signed terminal boundary without retry or forced power action.
test_case.expected_result: The BMC accepts the single Diagnostic Interrupt and the OS/platform exhibits exactly the approved diagnostic response—such as logged NMI or controlled panic/dump/reboot—with required evidence/dump integrity, then reaches the signed final healthy state through the approved recovery path.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires one authorized command, IPMI completion, exact expected OS/firmware terminal markers, dump integrity when required and final recovery. Zero ipmitool exit alone cannot pass. Ignored/unexpected NMI, missing dump, hang/boot loop, timeout or failed recovery is FAIL. Missing handler/oracle/recovery blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until target, workload drain, console/OOB, NMI/crashdump policy, dump capacity, timeout, final state and recovery are signed.
Explicit one-shot approval for the exact command/target.
Treat as potentially host-crashing; no active users/jobs and no automatic retry/reset/power action.
Stop on any target, dump, console, power, thermal or recovery anomaly.
expected_evidence: IPMI/OS diagnostic-interrupt specification and signed expected response/timeout
Drain, one-shot approval, console and dump/recovery readiness
Console/kernel/watchdog/panic/dump/reboot/SEL timeline and dump hash/identity if expected
Final host/BMC health, recovery and no-retry/no-log-clear audit
test_case.recovery: On hang, boot loop or dump failure, do not repeat the interrupt or force power automatically. Preserve console/SEL/dump evidence and invoke the pre-approved OOB/console recovery to the signed final state.
